proposals.before: He commanded the commanderies and feudal lords to establish high temples.
proposals.after: He commanded the commanderies and feudal kings to establish temples to Gaozu.
proposals.reason: 高廟 are ancestral temples to Gaozu (高祖), not generic 'high temples'; 諸侯王 are feudal kings.

decisions.reason: 十五稅一 is a tax of one part in fifteen (~6.7%), not fifteen percent; the proposed idiomatic wording restores that rate correctly.
The literal likewise misrenders 十五稅一 as fifteen percent; one-in-fifteen tax rate matches the Chinese fraction.
高廟 is Gaozu's ancestral temple, not a generic high temple, and 諸侯王 are feudal kings; the repair fixes both errors.
Same Chinese: 高廟 names Gaozu's temple and 諸侯王 are kings, so the literal replacement is accurate.
長樂宮鴻臺 is the Hong Terrace of Changle Palace; fused pinyin obscures the names, and palace 災 conventionally records fire.
